title: Stolen Signal
summary: Someone stole the dolls' testimonies from Judy's storeroom, and a courier is carrying them across Watson right now.

start.bringUp: Someone broke into the Mox storeroom and took the dolls' testimonies. Bring up, in your own way, that a courier is taking them across Watson right now and you need V to stop him.

little-china.name: the Little China checkpoint on Watson's edge

warehouse.name: the scav buyers' warehouse in Northside

J3.call.01.text: Someone hit the storeroom. They took the testimonies. The dolls' testimonies, V.

J3.call.02.text: If the wrong people see those, the girls in them are dead.

J3.call.03.text: Courier on a bike, Kabuki roundabout, right now. Sending you the ping.

J3.chase.01.text: That's him! Red bike, the case is strapped on the back.

J3.chase.02.text: Closer. Closer! Don't hit the case, hit the bike!

J3.chase.03.text: He's down. Get the case. If he runs, let him.

J3.chase.04.text: He made it to the warehouse. There are more of them.

J3.bark.01.text: V, where are you? He's getting away!

J3.buyer.01.text: Is the case okay? Tell me the case is okay.

J3.burn.01.text: You got it. You actually got it.

J3.burn.02.text: I don't know if I should finish the edit or burn every chip.

J3.burn.03.text: Okay. I finish it. And I lock it somewhere nobody's ever going to find.

J3.burn.04.text: Okay. I burn it. And I tell them myself.

J3.end.01.text: They got away with it. I'm warning the girls. Don't come by tonight.

g1.know: The testimonies' content in general terms, who is at risk, and that the Mox need them as evidence.
g1.secret: Evelyn once asked her to make a testimony like these, and she never finished it.

stages.label: Judy's holocall: the case is moving across Watson
stages.know: Someone broke into the Mox storeroom and took raw testimonies from the dolls. A courier on a red bike is taking the case across Watson right now.
stages.wants: V to get to the roundabout and catch the courier.

stages.label: V chases the courier across Watson
stages.know: The courier's bike is on a fixed route from the Kabuki roundabout through Little China to a Northside warehouse. Judy is watching the ping from her workshop.
stages.wants: V to stop the bike before it reaches the warehouse.

stages.label: The courier's buyers are at the warehouse
stages.know: Three scav buyers are taking the case at a Northside warehouse. They are the people who would sell the women's identities.
stages.wants: V to stop the buyers and take the case back.

stages.label: Judy decides what to do with the testimonies
stages.know: You have the case back. The testimonies are yours to finish or destroy, and you are not sure which you should do.
stages.wants: V's opinion on whether to finish the edit or burn the chips.

choices.means: V says Judy should finish the edit and lock the testimonies away
V says Judy should burn the chips and tell the women herself

caught-keep.memory: You chased down the courier who stole the dolls' testimonies across Watson, and Judy chose to finish the edit and lock it away.

caught-burn.memory: You chased down the courier who stole the dolls' testimonies across Watson, and Judy burned the chips and told the women herself.

recovered.memory: You stopped the scav buyers at a Northside warehouse and got the dolls' testimonies back before they were sold.

lost.memory: The dolls' testimonies were sold to scavs while you chased the courier. You tried, and Judy is warning the women.
